L.ARP-826.interpretation: Request/reply fields in network order; merge existing sender entry before target-address test, learn new sender only for local target, reply to targeted request.

L.ARP-CACHE.interpretation: Remove stale entries, prevent ARP request floods. Configurable cache TTL and1000ms one-retry policy are finite model choices.

L.ARP-PROFILE.interpretation: Explicit one-peer cache and Ethernet field/domain/short-entry/padding/service policies; not full ARP or host conformance.

L.UDP-WIRE.interpretation: Fields pages1/2: UDP header network octet layout, length includes8-byte header, IPv4 pseudoheader12 bytes, odd-byte padding only for checksum and transmit computed zero represented as65535.

L.UDP-DEFAULT.interpretation: 4.1.3.4: checksum generation defaults on with application configuration permitted.

L.IP-WIRE.interpretation: 3.1: version/IHL, total length, flags/fragment offset, TTL, protocol17, header checksum and source/destination layout.

L.ATOMIC-ID.interpretation: 4/4.1: DF1,MF0,offset0 datagrams are atomic; their ID may have any value. This slice chooses0.

L.PROFILE.interpretation: Fixed local documentation-address pair and ports40000/8080, TTL64, DF1, ID0, no options/fragments; data<=1472 fits assumed MTU1500. Transmit only, no routing/ARP/receive/ICMP/physical peer.

L.COMPOSED-PROFILE.interpretation: One explicit EFSM combining inherited ARP with the same UDP transmit byte AST; component PROFILE describes UDP construction only, new full scope here.

L.ARP-PACKET-QUEUE.interpretation: One fixed unresolved neighbor: retain latest accepted packet, transmit after resolution; replacement does not reset ARP retry budget; failure clears slot.

L.ETH-IP.interpretation: EtherType0800, destination learned through ARP, zero padding to minimum46 payload bytes excluded from IP length; maximum1500-byte IPv4 datagram.

L.ETH-ERRATA.interpretation: Interpret original Frame Format 1500 minimum typo as maximum1500; preserve original RFC text.

L.ENDPOINT-INGRESS.interpretation: Finite fixed-link profile; full frame bounds/canonical padding checked before raw IP slice; ingress does not learn ARP or alter queued TX.

L.ENDPOINT-LINK.interpretation: Ethernet IPv4 type0800; padding excluded from IP length/checksum. Canonical extent is finite profile policy, arbitrary input pad ignored and output zero padded.

L.UDPRX-RX-PROFILE.interpretation: Preserve existing raw component policy within explicitly checked fixed Ethernet ingress envelope; independent module variables; three inherited ARP states.

L.UDPRX-IP-LENGTH.interpretation: IPv4 Total Length includes header and data; this raw-entry profile requires exact datagram bytes.

L.UDPRX-IP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Verify each admitted fixed IPv4 header; invalid checksum silently discards.

L.UDPRX-UDP-LENGTH.interpretation: UDP length includes eight-byte header and data; surplus beyond UDP length remains out of scope.

L.UDPRX-UDP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Discard invalid nonzero checksum; optionally discard absent checksum. This profile defaults to allowing absent checksums.

L.UDPRX-UDP-PSEUDO.interpretation: Checksum covers pseudoheader with IP addresses/protocol/UDP length plus UDP header/data. Zero means absent; FFFF validates normally.

L.UDPRX-IP-ATOMIC-ID.interpretation: Only DF1/MF0/offset0 packets: ignore arbitrary ID for admission/duplicate semantics; original ID octets remain checked by the IPv4 checksum.

L.ECHO-ECHO-PROFILE.interpretation: Preserve existing raw component policy within explicitly checked fixed Ethernet ingress envelope; independent module variables; three inherited ARP states.

L.ECHO-ECHO-REPLY.interpretation: Reverse addresses, type0/code0, unchanged identifier/sequence and all data; recompute checksum including odd zero pad for arithmetic only.

L.ECHO-ECHO-HOST.interpretation: Echo server and same specific-destination source/data preservation, within declared unicast profile only.

L.ECHO-IP-LENGTH.interpretation: Exact raw datagram length in this nonfragmented IHL5 profile.

L.ECHO-IP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Verify IPv4 header checksum and silently discard invalid datagram.

L.ECHO-ICMP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Validate ones-complement checksum over complete ICMP message; no UDP absent/zero remapping. Invalid admitted message silently discarded by profile policy.

L.ECHO-IP-ATOMIC.interpretation: DF1/MF0/off0: input ID ignored for semantics but checked by checksum; output atomic ID0 profile choice.

L.COMPONENT-STATE-DOMAIN.interpretation: Internal control variable represents the original finite component state under default initialization.

T.CONN-OPEN.interpretation: Select ISS; active OPEN enters SYN-SENT, passive OPEN enters LISTEN.

T.CONN-LISTEN.interpretation: A SYN in LISTEN initializes receive state and emits SYN+ACK; ACK-bearing input emits RST; RST is ignored.

T.CONN-SYN-SENT.interpretation: Validate ACK before processing SYN/RST; valid SYN+ACK establishes, bare SYN enters SYN-RECEIVED.

T.CONN-SIMULTANEOUS.interpretation: Figure 7: active vs passive origin is retained in SYN-RECEIVED; simultaneous SYN+ACK completes synchronization.

T.CONN-ACK.interpretation: In-order ACK completes synchronization or acknowledges FIN, with per-state transitions.

T.CONN-FIN.interpretation: FIN consumes one receive sequence number, is acknowledged, and changes per-state close progression.

T.CONN-CLOSE.interpretation: CLOSE in ESTABLISHED or CLOSE-WAIT emits FIN and enters FIN-WAIT-1 or LAST-ACK; repeated close does not emit a second FIN.

T.CONN-ABORT.interpretation: ABORT sends RST in the specified synchronized states; other states discard the TCB without output RST.

T.CONN-RESET.interpretation: Exact RCV.NXT resets the connection; passive SYN-RECEIVED returns to LISTEN, active origin closes.

T.CONN-CLOSED-INPUT.interpretation: CLOSED ignores resets and emits a correctly formatted reset for other control segments.

T.CONN-TIMEOUT.interpretation: User timeout deletes the TCB; retransmission timeout repeats oldest outstanding segment; TIME-WAIT timeout closes.

T.RTO-PROFILE.interpretation: Use 1000ms initial SYN RTO and exponential doubling for control retransmission. After a SYN timeout use at least 3000ms for subsequent FIN, retaining a larger backed-off value; no RTT estimator is modeled.

T.CONNECTION-PROFILE.interpretation: Inherited single-connection control paths retain validated control shapes, exact sequence checks and configurable user/MSL deadlines. The data extension supersedes the base zero-payload assumption only in ESTABLISHED, within the explicit DATA-SCOPE boundary; data in other lifecycle states remains excluded.

T.DATA-SEQ.interpretation: Each new data octet consumes one sequence number; cumulative ACK removes an acknowledged prefix. Retransmission does not advance SND.NXT.

T.DATA-ACK.interpretation: New ACKs satisfy SND.UNA < SEG.ACK <= SND.NXT; duplicate and old ACKs do not remove data; future ACK triggers an ACK.

T.DATA-WINDOW.interpretation: Update SND.WND only for acceptable ACK and newer WL1/WL2. Segmentation respects the available advertised send window.

T.DATA-RECEIVE.interpretation: Accept and trim text overlapping the receive window; advance RCV.NXT only over contiguous newly accepted bytes, ACK the next expected octet.

T.DATA-SEND.interpretation: Model buffers application octets and segments them within the configured capacity, MSS and send window.

T.DATA-RTX.interpretation: The retransmission timer sends the oldest outstanding data again. This profile uses fixed initial RTO and exponential backoff only.

T.DATA-RTO.interpretation: Start on first outstanding transmission, restart on new partial ACK, cancel on all acknowledged, retransmit oldest on expiry and double RTO (5.1-5.6). No RTT sampling or maximum retry policy.

T.DATA-SCOPE.interpretation: Finite single-connection profile, 16-byte send and receive capacity, MSS=4, handshake-advertised peer window, immediate ACK and explicit flush scheduler. Future/out-of-order data discarded without reassembly. Close requires buffers drained. No implementation conformance claim.

T.WIRE-PROFILE.interpretation: Finite raw IPv4 TCP wire transport of unchanged tcp-data protocol state/actions; unsupported domain remains model_gap. Drops modify only wire disposition.

T.WIRE-IP.interpretation: Explicit fixed IPv4 layout, Total Length and header checksum; atomic ID0 output/any input ID within RFC6864 profile.

T.WIRE-TCP.interpretation: Explicit sequence/ack/window/flags, Data Offset, checksum and pseudoheader, with only declared fixed option shapes.

T.WIRE-MSS.interpretation: SYNACK may carry only kind2,length4,MSS>=4; existing SMSS4 output remains at or below offered MSS; no negotiation/storage fork.

T.WIRE-PUSH.interpretation: Profile sends every nonempty segment with PSHACK and accepts ACK/PSHACK data through the same original byte/sequence rules; receive API does not expose optional PUSH flag. Explicit flush service remains an environment scheduling contract.

T.COMPONENT-STATE-DOMAIN.interpretation: Internal control variable represents the original finite component state under default initialization.

CROSS-IP-LINK.interpretation: finite explicit automatic ARP and shared latest raw IP pending slot; not an RFC mandated queue policy

TCP-IP-FRAME-DROP.interpretation: explicit drop for bounds-only malformed TCP IP total length, declared finite policy

VIRTUAL-ETHERNET-RX.interpretation: Finite virtual Ethernet receive service boundary admits exact IPv4 extent or canonical padding; physical TX padding and every other protocol guard/action are unchanged.

L.TAP-INTERFACE.interpretation: Pinned v6.12 TUN/TAP document describes userspace replacement of physical media and TAP Ethernet frame I/O; it does not mandate padding behavior or prove a runner kernel implementation.

L.TAP-EXTENT.interpretation: Declared finite interface union: exactly14+IPtotal or canonical max60 extent; no adapter normalization; malformed Total Length drops before any extraction, partial padding remains gap. Original canonical module unchanged.
